root_cause.mechanism: C2 boot reached the ownership seam without the MEGA65 I/O personality. The correct descriptor was built in RAM, but accesses to $D700-$D705 did not address DMAgic, so no publication occurred.
root_cause.why_the_crc_failed: The unchanged physical $E000 window did not match the pinned Attic image after MAP.
root_cause.why_the_screen_was_black: The fail-closed return occurs after interrupts are masked and before product display ownership is published.

required_fix_and_gate.product_fix: Repeat the complete $D02F $47/$53 MEGA65 I/O knock immediately after SEI/LDZ and before the first CIA, VIC or DMA register access.
required_fix_and_gate.layout_payment: Place the 11-byte knock/RTS helper in the post-facade gap; pay the ownership JSR by omitting the redundant D704 write and recover the helper's eleventh byte with the equivalent LDQ MAP operand initialization.
required_fix_and_gate.permanent_gate: Disassembly and mutations bind SEI, LDZ #0, the immediate fixed helper call, the exact $47/$53 sequence, D702 clearing D704, and all fixed low-resident addresses.
required_fix_and_gate.hardware_recheck: A fresh candidate must restart the receipt-less pre-smoke at manual step 1; no Link-20 green is inherited.

claim_limit: Receipt-less hardware diagnosis of Link 20 only. It proves a first-red at the I/O-personality boundary and no hardware acceptance, product promotion or release claim.
